cash.name: CORRA compounded cash proxy (CAD)
cash.note: Derived from daily CORRA using ACT/365 accrual across business-day gaps; not an investable deposit return or an official total-return index. The 10Y window spans the June 2020 methodology change.

reference.method: Buy-and-hold terminal-wealth blend; no rebalancing, fees or taxes. Equity and bond component CAGRs are the rounded published CAD total-return index figures. CORRA is a calculated overnight cash proxy. No intervening return path is inferred.
